title: ML tool stratifies catheter ablation benefit in atrial fibrillation with heart failure
summary: Unsupervised clustering and supervised learning on 25 clinical features from the China-AF registry (3122 patients, 31 hospitals) identified three risk clusters with composite event rates per 100 person-years of 7.7, 6.8 and 3.8. External validation used 778 patients from the CABANA trial and showed a similar pattern (adjusted HR 0.19 for ablation in the benefiting group, 95% CI 0.05-0.73). The tool was derived from observational data and the authors state that interventional trials are needed to confirm its usefulness.
